portInfo.description: API Puerto Vallarta operates the maritime terminal on the primary northern hotel-zone boulevard at Km 4.5. The authority’s “Cómo llegar” page explains car, urban bus and cruise-ship arrival patterns, waiting halls, and berth-specific return doors for international cruise passengers. Cruise movement statistics for 2026 are published as downloadable spreadsheets/images on the API statistics page — figures were not transcribed into this guide pending careful parsing of the XLSX. Multiple international cruise lines call regularly per the same how-to-arrive page.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Hotel-zone beach near terminal — shortest logistics — ~90 min.
Malecón / Centro — taxi/bus; minutes Not verified — ~120 min ashore once there.
Zona Romántica — further south; long-call only.
Bay boat / snorkel tours — organised; weather Jun–Oct wet.
Sierra Madre day trips — organised only.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. Hotel-zone beach or short taxi to nearer sights; note reboard gate number before leaving.
thingsToDo.standardCall: ≥6 h. Malecón + lunch with ≥90 min return; confirm Muelle/Puerta.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Botanical gardens / sierra tours need verified timing; wet-season roads slow returns.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Photograph your Muelle number and matching Puerta (3 / 11 / 17) before heading downtown — returning to the wrong gate burns buffer.
